title: Excess resurrections
description: REQ-STAT-BASE, REQ-STAT-SHIFT, REQ-STAT-PLACEBO. `shift` is the time-shift permutation result and `placebo` the placebo-outcome excess; both optional (ops#64).

shift.description: REQ-STAT-SHIFT: observed count against the distribution of counts under random time shifts. Fields: runs, seed, observed, mean, q025, q975 (numbers). Inner fields are not type-checked so the methods page can say a result is missing instead of failing the whole file (ops#64).

placebo.description: REQ-STAT-PLACEBO: excess for a placebo outcome that should be about zero. Fields: excess, lo, hi (numbers). Inner fields are not type-checked, see `shift`.
